steps.speaker: Piercing Shriek
steps.content: ...!
[Corruptor portrait,
portrait disappears]
Hypatia shatters the monster before her. The creature crumbles into black sand, flowing back into the dark magnetic vortex.

Above, the barrier has been torn open, leaving a gaping hole where black sand funnels into Furor. That's the Apostle of Ashes. It eyes its prey hungrily, yet cautiously refuses to fully take the bait.
The black sand accelerates its erosion of Furor's last defenses. The barrier grows increasingly unstable. It won't hold much longer.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Huff... huff...
The storm intensifies, carrying razor-sharp metal fragments that slice across Hypatia's exposed skin, leaving one deep cut after another.
A different sound is hidden within the howling gale.

steps.speaker: Whispers in the Storm
steps.content: Lady... Lady Hypatia...
Someone is left behind in Furor?!
No, that's not a real voice. Mania is contaminating her mind. This is the Apostle's trap.

She tries to drive the hallucinations out of her mind, but her vision only grows more disoriented. The ruined streets begin to blur with memories of Furor's once-bustling avenues, phantom figures seemingly standing right beside her, talking to her.

steps.speaker: Whispers in the Storm
steps.content: The Campbells' wish... We all understand... We chose to stay behind...
The metal fragments collide in the wind, creating faint noises. Through Mania's influence, these sounds transform into whispers that penetrate the ears of the last living soul in Furor.

steps.speaker: Whispers in the Storm
steps.content: Hypatia... Don't betray us... Never forget...

steps.speaker: Whispers in the Storm
steps.content: ...Hypatia! Don't betray the family! Never forget your duty!
The whispers suddenly amplify, transforming into a deafening explosion in her ears.
Seizing the opening, the Corruptor before Hypatia strikes with full force, sending her body flying into the heart of the black sandstorm.
[Black Screen]
Hypatia is ensnared by the Apostle's Mania field.

Something flies past her. Remnants of prey captured by the storm but not yet fully consumed. Aurum Secretum debris, broken Furorian rosaries, and countless unrecognizable relics from other fallen cities.

Deep inside the Apostle's bowels, her consciousness is getting torn apart. She struggles to resist, but is dragged deeper into the contamination. She hears whispers and resentful shrieks of the deceased.
But among them, there's another voice, childlike and innocent. It's...
[WHITE OUT, Dream Flashback]

steps.speaker: Solemn Voice
steps.content: ...Do you hereby swear that from this day forward, as a Campbell child of Fraser, you will dedicate yourself wholly to your family and this city, leading its people toward prosperity?
[CG - Flashback A]
Sunlight streams down. The girl stands bathed in its glow, her right hand resting gently over her chest, feeling the cold metal beneath her fingers and the rapid beating of her own heart.

steps.speaker: Youthful Voice
steps.content: Yes, I swear.

steps.speaker: Solemn Voice
steps.content: Do you hereby swear that you, as one of the revered Campbells, will do everything in your power to carry forward the guidance of your great predecessors and never dishonor the glory of your family?

steps.speaker: Youthful Voice
steps.content: Yes, I will be true to my word and deed, never forgetting the compassion and justice in my heart.

steps.speaker: Solemn Voice
steps.content: Do you swear before the Golden Rose that no matter the hardship, whatever the cost, you will never abandon your duty or betray your oath, and always put the greater interests before your own?
The childish voice answers without a moment's hesitation, resolute and unwavering.

steps.speaker: Youthful Voice
steps.content: Yes, I do.

steps.speaker: Youthful Voice
steps.content: I do. I will be forever faithful to my duty, my city, and its people.

steps.speaker: Youthful Voice
steps.content: Even if it means sacrificing everything I have, I shall not hesitate...
[The young Hypatia's spirited pledge continues, but as she raises her head to accept the honor, the illusion suddenly shatters.]

steps.speaker: Solemn Voice
steps.content: Liar! Traitor!
[CG - Flashback B]
Her memories shatter under the harsh voice. Countless fragments interweave and overlap as a symphony of voices echoes around Hypatia.

steps.speaker: Close Whispers
steps.content: The disaster is still intensifying. The Apostle's activity has exceeded the threshold. Lady Hypatia, the barrier won't hold much longer...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: How naive I was. I once believed in Aurum Secretum, and that perhaps one day my research could conquer the calamity and save the world.

steps.speaker: Close Whispers
steps.content: If not for Furor, we'd have died in WhiteSands long ago... But our lives are worthless anyway. It's our honor to die for Aurum Secretum...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: But one person's efforts are so feeble. People are dying for the hope that might never come... while I accomplished even less than the Aurum Secretum they died for.

steps.speaker: Close Whispers
steps.content: Hypatia, you've betrayed your oath!

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: No, the glory of the Campbells... true glory should never be something like this...
[Transition to Black Screen]
The contamination continues to intensify. Hypatia struggles to resist, yet escaping the corruption seems almost impossible.

steps.speaker: Close Whispers
steps.content: What more do you want? Your family believes in you and has invested so much in you, placing their highest hopes in you, and yet you betray them for some useless research site? What a fool!

steps.speaker: Close Whispers
steps.content: This is merely a small, inevitable sacrifice on the path to great victory... Accept it, and only then can you go further...
The whispers circle around her ears, seducing her to surrender and plunge together into the depths of darkness.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: N-no, that's wrong... I...
The howling in the wind grows louder. Hands from the darkness seize Hypatia, dragging her down into the abyss, and then...

steps.speaker: Clear Voice
steps.content: I say to hell with them!
The sandy storm dances, devouring everything at an accelerating pace. But somewhere deeper, a rift opens in the chaotic void, allowing bits of light from the outside to shine through.
The darkness begins to crumble as the light draws closer, growing brighter and more distinct...

steps.speaker: Clear Voice
steps.content: You're a Campbell and the inventor of Aurum Secretum! What can't you do?

steps.speaker: Clear Voice
steps.content: Come on, Hypatia! Get back here. We're not done fighting yet!
[Background - City Center - Day]
Hypatia's eyes snap open.

She sees no researchers, no Furorians, no Campbell messengers here. And of course, she doesn't see Hella either. Everything just now was merely an illusion she saw after being swallowed by the Apostle's Mania field.
...I see. Individuals swallowed by an Apostle aren't immediately consumed. Instead, they're drawn into the Apostle's own spiritual domain and experience hallucinations.

steps.speaker: Apostle of Ashes
steps.content: ...!

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: You should work on your dream-crafting skills though. You won't catch much prey like that.
The Aurum Secretum emits a hum. Her power concentrates once more as she breaks free from the Apostle's tempest.

The wind transforms into piercing screams that sweep across the space. Everything around her shakes as the barrier teeters on the verge of collapse. Instead of countering immediately, Hypatia pulls out her recording device.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...The evacuation should be complete by now. It's time.
Another crack appears. The barrier stops shaking all of a sudden.

Hypatia looks up while her device records everything: The wind outside has suddenly stopped. A massive shadow is gathering in the air, hovering above Furor, blotting out the sky and nearly engulfing the tiny figure below.
She's still breathing heavily, and her hands tremble violently from pain, or perhaps something else.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: So... is this what you're after? To be a glorious, lonely hero that no one will remember?
Just like all Furorians, she's nothing more than an ordinary person.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...See, even now I'm still frightened. How could someone like me ever be their hope?
The illusion mirrors her pain and longing. A solo fight is too lonely. Perhaps, somewhere deep in her heart, she does wish someone could stand beside her.
The recording device is still working dutifully. Hypatia steadies her breathing slowly before speaking again. This time, a trace of hesitation seeps into her otherwise composed voice.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: When this is all over, if someone finds this recording... if anyone hears these words...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Then, perhaps it might still be possible to...
Her sentence is left unfinished. The Aurum Secretum barrier shatters completely, its fragments raining down like falling stars over the city.
Almost instantly, an invisible gaze locks onto her. In the next moment, Mania floods into Furor together with the sandy storm.
